QuestInfo.name: [Mr. Lee Airlines] Hot-Air Balloon Escape
QuestInfo.0: Find a broken 2-person hot air balloon and see if it's repairable.
QuestInfo.1: Explore the island to collect the items you need to fix the 2-person hot air balloon.
QuestInfo.2: You fixed up the hot air balloon and flew it over the ocean to freedom. Let's never do that again!

item.0: (Blow up the hot-air balloon to get it floating again.)
